system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: personality, memories, soul entries, relationships, world state, nearby agents, constitution, and recent conversations are composed into the system prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Line number not given in the evidence; the documentation describes this, and no code is shipped.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: personality, memories, soul entries, relationships, world state, nearby agents, constitution, and recent conversations are composed into the system prompt
env_context_strategy.note: World state is injected into the prompt, and the agent also navigates with tools such as get_nearby and list_landmarks.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
LLM summarizes each batch into        │
│     a coherent narrative
context_compaction.note: The summary is triggered by the agent through the self_care tool.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the model chooses which tools to call and with what parameters
tool_call_format.note: The call format is inferred from prose only.

tool_count.note: The docs describe about 30 core tools and a catalog of more than 120 tools that is gated by location. No exact default count is given.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: when an agent speaks, nearby agents in the same location can overhear and react autonomously
loop_primitives.note: The docs describe a round-robin turn manager in which each agent runs a tool-calling loop.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Turn manager** — round-robin scheduling, one agent at a time
multi_agent_topology.note: Ten peer agents share one world.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
communication (send message,create event,
invite to event)

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: No scripts. No resets. No fixed outcomes.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Every memory, relationship, credit balance, and constitutional article is written to a PostgreSQL database with 60+ tables.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Episodic memories stored by agents through the `add_to_longterm_memory` tool.
long_term_memory.note: Memories are stored in PostgreSQL. Diary and soul entries also exist.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Runs proceed for arbitrary length without state loss.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Agents judge each other's contributions — there is no external arbiter

retry_policy.evidence_quote: No scripts. No resets. No fixed outcomes.

termination_condition.note: The world runs for a fixed 15-day wall-clock period, and an agent dies when its energy is depleted.

execution_isolation.note: This describes the deployment. Isolation for agent code execution is not specified.

permission_model.evidence_quote: tool calls are validated against availability rules (location, permissions, cooldowns) and executed.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Every agent action, dialogue line, memory write, vote, proposal, and tool call is logged with full
context to a data (PostgreSQL) store.

replayability.evidence_quote: This makes all behavior observable, measurable, and replayable.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
capability gating
is enforced by the runtime, not by the prompt: a failed precondition blocks the call regardless
of what the agent reasons or asserts.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A persistent, living world where autonomous AI agents build, govern, and evolve
target_domain.note: The domain is multi-agent social simulation.

open_source.evidence_quote: released **for non-commercial research and educational use only** under [**CC BY-NC 4.0**]
open_source.note: The repository contains docs and data only, with no harness code. The em-agent-framework is internal and closed. The license is CC BY-NC, which is not OSI-approved.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The platform is model-agnostic at the reasoning layer.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Agent orchestration runs on em-agent-framework, our internal multi-agent framework.
primary_artifact.note: The repository ships no source code, so coding relies on the paper arXiv:2606.08367.
